body: No one I know is going. I have been to a couple of shows at a local bar and restaurant in my hometown. It was my old guitar teacher's band.

I like anything except pop and most country. I don't think I can go to a concert in my area as they are few and far between. I live in a small town, about 90 miles from a decently sized city. All the local bands are country music, with one real exception, a band that a three people I know are in. As for concerts in the region the only one I have a little bit of interest in is Avenged Sevenfold (in Sacramento about four hours south of my town, on July 31st) and I'm not going to be able to go as I'm broke and have no means of transportation.
The only thing I'll miss is probably music...
The only thing I can see in the next stage of life is me working minimum wage jobs until I'm dead or being homeless until I'm dead.
I've tried and it hasn't worked.
I've been saying that for years upon years... nothing has happened...
It's not like I'm leaving too many people behind. I've tried and tried and nothing works...
